description: This Java class 'SsrfProtectionValidator' provides mechanisms for validating URIs to prevent Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) attacks. It includes checks for allowed schemes, blocked hostnames and suffixes, IP address validation, and CIDR range blocking, with configurable allowlists and blocklists.

classes.name: SsrfProtectionValidator
classes.description: A utility class for validating URIs against SSRF attack vectors, with configurable allowlists and blocklists, and CIDR range checks.

classes.name: CidrRange
classes.description: Represents an IP CIDR range with methods to parse, check containment, and convert to string.

methods.name: validateUri
methods.description: Validates a URI to ensure it uses allowed schemes, hostnames, and IP addresses, throwing an exception if invalid.

methods.name: validateUri
methods.description: Internal method that performs detailed validation of the URI with respect to SSRF protection settings.

methods.name: validateResolvedAddresses
methods.description: Resolves hostname to IP addresses and checks if any are blocked.

methods.name: isBlockedAddress
methods.description: Checks if a given InetAddress is within blocked ranges or is a loopback/local address.

methods.name: throwBlockedHost
methods.description: Throws a RuntimeException indicating the host is not allowed.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether SSRF protection is enabled.

methods.name: setAdditionalBlockedHosts
methods.description: Configures additional CIDR or hostname blocks.

methods.name: setAllowedHosts
methods.description: Configures allowed CIDR ranges and hostnames.

methods.name: isHostnameAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a hostname is in the allowed list.

methods.name: parseHostEntries
methods.description: Parses a list of host entries into CIDR ranges and hostnames.

methods.name: isIpLiteral
methods.description: Determines if a string is an IP literal (IPv4 or IPv6).
